name: Sumo Battle Prototype
author: john3rd73_unity
description:
This is the Sumo Battle Prototype from Unit 4 - Gameplay Mechanics of the Unity Jr. Programmer Pathway. 

Use the up and down arrows to move the checkered sphere; right and left arrows to rotate the plane. Use the PowerUps to repel the enemies..but not for long. Before you know it, another wave of enemies and PowerUps appear!
